newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar steady as NY fails to inspire.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar steady as NY fails to inspire.

text.p: White sugar futures held steady in light Monday trading as the expected rally on the raws market failed to hold momentum and disappointed bullish sentiment on the whites, traders said. While London's spot March contract edged slightly higher in the earlier part of the session, values fell short of any serious test of resistance and the range was tight at $1.30. By 1703 GMT March was down 10 cents at $311.80 but steady broker buying through the day kept it from dipping too far under the previous settlement. May was down by the same amount at $310.80 and overall volume was light at 584 lots.

Physical news was thin on the ground, although traders cited talk that Iraq had concluded a deal to buy between four and six cargoes of refined white sugar under the U.N. oil-for-food deal. The origin was likely to be European, they said, but added that details of price were as yet unclear.

The terms of Iraq's original tender specify either Brazil or France but also a range of qualities between the European 45 ICUMSA standard and lesser-quality 100 ICUMSA. Paris positions were firmer across the board but volume was also light at 443 lots. March was up 20 cents at $311.50 and May up 60 cents at $311.00.
